from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
 h=len(g)//3; w=len(g[0])//3; out=[]
 for i in range(h):
  row=[]
  for j in range(w):
   c=Counter(x for r in g[i*3:i*3+3] for x in r[j*3:j*3+3] if x!=5)
   row.append(c.most_common(1)[0][0] if c else 0)
  out.append(row)
 return out
out=transform(grid); print(out)
